verdict.rationale: The only explicit bulk capability is "Bulk outreach campaigns," which sends automated, personalized messages at scale. The API can advance, move and reject applications, but nothing says it does so in batches rather than one item at a time. Missing for 10: general bulk actions across many candidates or applications (bulk move, reject or update), batch API endpoints, bulk operations reachable by AI agents, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
